# Lazur

> Lazur is an AI buddy for Mac that lives in the MacBook notch. Hold a key and talk:
> Lazur sees your screen when you ask, answers out loud, points at things by drawing
> on your screen, walks you through apps step by step, gets everyday tasks done
> (timers, reminders, calendar, notes, music, apps, links, Shortcuts), runs longer
> research jobs in the background, and types for you in any app.

## Product
- Name: Lazur
- Category: AI buddy / personal AI assistant for macOS
- Tagline: Your AI buddy, right in the notch.
- Platform: macOS (Apple silicon and Intel). Windows is planned.
- Website: https://www.lazur.app
- Download: https://www.lazur.app/download
- Pricing: https://www.lazur.app/pricing
- Changelog: https://www.lazur.app/changelog
- Latest version: 0.1.11 (October 28, 2026); updates install automatically

## How it works
- Hold ⌥ ⌘ (Option + Command) to ask about anything on screen; Lazur answers out loud.
- Ask where something is and Lazur draws a circle and label around it on your screen.
- Ask how to do something and it guides you one click at a time, waiting for each click.
- Everyday actions by voice: timers in the notch, Apple Reminders, Calendar events, notes, music and volume, opening apps and links, web search, Shortcuts.
- Background jobs: research and reading run in Lazur's own Chrome tabs (via the Lazur for Chrome extension) and come back with a summary and a full report.
- Hold fn to dictate clean, formatted text at the cursor in any app; snippets, a personal dictionary (Words) and clipboard slots included.

## Privacy
- Lazur listens and looks at the screen only while you hold its shortcut.
- Audio and the screenshot for that request are sent to AI providers to answer and are not stored.
- Content is never used to train AI models.
- Details: https://www.lazur.app/privacy

## Pricing (October 2026)
- Every plan starts with a 3-day Pro trial; no credit card. The trial starts when you first open the app.
- Pro: $18/month ($15/month billed annually), 150 AI actions a month, unlimited dictation.
- Power: $120/month ($96/month billed annually), 1,000 AI actions a month, unlimited dictation.
- An AI action is one thing you ask Lazur to do (a question, a pointed-at button, a reminder or a background job). Dictation doesn't count.

## Who it's for
- Anyone learning new software (step-by-step guidance on their own screen)
- Founders and operators (replies, scheduling, research in the background)
- Students (explanations of what's on screen, notes, deadlines)
- Developers (errors explained in the editor, commit messages by voice)
- People who type a lot and would rather talk
